summary: The puzzle move list's "Moves" label sat inline beside the step buttons in a shrinking row, so it wrapped mid-word ("Mov / es") on phone and desktop and starved the move strip until the first chip was clipped ("Nxe5" read "ке5"). The label now heads the move list on its own row (with the step buttons at that row's end) without wrapping, and the moves take the full width under it and wrap onto a further row rather than scroll, so no chip is cut at an edge.
